purpose: U01/L01 / PRD §4 and F15: original decorative crowd for the landing footer

operations.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original Petal website footer illustration, transparent horizontal crowd banner. Primary request: a warm group of adult women uniting together, standing close with a few arms naturally resting around neighbors' shoulders. Create one cohesive wide panoramic editorial composition about 3:1, 14 women in two gently overlapping staggered rows, cropped at mid-torso along a unified lower edge. Every woman must be visibly different: varied natural skin tones from deep brown through medium brown and tan to pale, distinctive silhouettes and body sizes, varied ages from young adults to older adults, short afro, close-cropped curls, long braids, bob, ponytail, gray waves, a woman in a simple hijab, some wearing glasses. Calm friendly expressions, discreet simple facial features, coherent anatomy, relaxed inclusion without exaggerated cheering. Petal's original style: flat modern editorial vector-like solid shapes, soft organic rounded silhouettes, deep plum hair and sparse plum internal lines, alternating rose #B83D70, blush #FCE8EF, muted plum #745D69, soft white #FFF7FA and white clothing; natural skin colors only on people. All faces and identities original, not copied from any reference. Composition fills the wide canvas horizontally, heads form a lively uneven upper silhouette, foreground women slightly larger, clear distinct faces with restrained facial detail, subtle gestures of support. Transparent background and generous clear transparent space above the tallest heads; tiny transparent margin left/right, entire heads and hair must remain within canvas, all torsos end naturally at the bottom baseline. No lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, badges, medical props, scenery, ground plane, gradients, grain, shadows, 3D or photorealism. Solid flat fills and clean antialiased edges. This must harmonize with an existing rose/plum flat illustration collection.

Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. Refine this original Petal footer crowd artwork. Preserve the wide 3:1 transparent canvas, all 14 adult women, two overlapping rows, natural skin-tone diversity, rose/blush/plum/white clothing and supportive arm-around-shoulder arrangement. Make it a truly FLAT modern editorial illustration, not polished portrait painting: use simple solid fill areas, remove facial/body modeling, gradients, skin shadows, makeup highlights and textured hair detail. Keep just restrained minimal dark-plum face details: small eyes, simple nose, gently smiling mouth; preserve mature adult expression and varied ages. Distinguish the foreground women more strongly: change the central foreground woman's long black waves to a chin-length straight blunt bob and a rounded fuller face; change the foreground woman just left of center with black side-parted hair to a short asymmetrical pixie cut and narrower face; give the foreground woman at far right dark-plum rectangular glasses and a high ponytail. Keep the other women recognizable but clearly separate through face shape, hair, body and clothing. Preserve respectful hijab and older gray-haired figures. Clean all alpha edges: remove colored fringe, stray marks and ragged bottom fragments, with a crisp unified lower torso baseline. Maintain actual transparency above/between people and at tiny outside side margins. No extra people, missing faces, repeated identical faces, embedded text, logos, watermark, background or objects. Match Petal's flat rounded silhouettes, calm adult faces and palette; no outlines heavier than necessary, no photorealism, no decorative grain or shading. Do not change scene purpose or layout.
operations.referenceRole: Original generated crowd; two supplied screenshots informed layout and composition, not copied identity.
